lines.x: You would like to be my 'kung fu recorder?' The way Rhodes Island treats its guests truly moves me. It is no wonder my sisters love this place so much… I misunderstand? No problem, I have no qualms with being your subordinate either.

Doctor.' Your title reminds me of the Yanese scholars. Experienced and knowledgeable, they see the forest for the trees. You feel like we've met before? It's true that after awakening from my dream of chaos, I have traveled to many places... Sadly, the more friends I make, the lonelier I feel. Perhaps we are alike in that respect.

As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.
The spring comes and goes, leaving a lonely autumn.

Doctor, thank you kindly for taking care of my sisters. I hope you will excuse me for intruding upon Rhodes Island for a little while. Please call me 'Chongyue.' It's a name given to me by... an old friend of mine.
The colors that once embellished the autumn grass, hues long buried by war.

Often I think about those soldiers who traveled from all corners of Great Yan to Yumen. They risked their lives in battle until death took them, or their age crept upon themselves... yet never for their own ends.
Battles we have fought, death we have braved. Doctor, no need to say more.
Lit, quenched, then lit again… The signal fires never ever rest.
In that case, Doctor, will you beat the drums for me as we sortie?
The sunset weaves a silken river. Heaven and earth bolster me upon departure.
Warriors from afar rest scarce, the armor they wear spurs them to march.
One should spar from time to time.
At your command.
Look at this spectacular sight. Alas, it is now a battlefield.
Many intellectuals must join a battle before penning a decent verse, including that sister of mine… This too is an opportunity.
Unsteady posture, wavering intent. Much to learn yet.
A thousand moves in one breath!
Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft.
After all this time, you still turn to war for solutions!
You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.
A thousand armies move at the beating of your war drums, with a handful of sand to clean the blood from one's armor... What a tremendous victory!
There is never a true victory in brandishing a sword and formulating a strategy, while looking for gains and losses is an even greater folly. So long as you leave no regrets, then all is well.
All warriors must face defeat. Don't lose heart.
This is much more comfortable than a military tent. Can I even manage a good night's sleep without the sound of drilling soldiers…?
Doctor, have you figured out how to counter that move from yesterday?
The times are changing, and man along with them. So too does the scenery change.
Arknights.

Nian, Dusk, and Ling are already drunk? It's not often Rhodes Island gets this lively...Let them be. Relax, I will keep an eye on them. Our sibling 'reunion' may be an extraordinary event to most, but this too is human nature. Who are we to reject participation in these traditions?
Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

Once I traveled through Sargon and taught the locals a few moves for their defense. From what I heard, they became very fierce and instigated many riots. Ever since, I have been careful who I teach. This booklet contains instructions on how to strengthen your body and health. Take it. It is a joyous day, after all.

Yumen throws a banquet rather like this every year, to reward its warriors for their work the year prior. The men would clatter their weapons and sing along with the beat. But the next morning, they would still be up for duty, no matter how inebriated. Just like that, Yumen has traversed the lands and defended Great Yan's peace for a hundred years. Doctor, what is it that you defend?

Are you interested in this continuity log, Doctor? We film our shots in a shuffled order, different from how they appear in the final product. So if we lose this log, the editor will be in trouble. Uh... actually, I'm looking for a page that went missing... Could you help me check the back of that prop box? I think it may be hiding there.

Doctor, I'm here to serve as stunt coordinator for Nian's motion picture. The actors here have never been trained in kung fu, but you will find that their diligent rehearsal is no less impressive or touching. What? The male lead is injured? Ai-ya... what should we do...? Ah? You want me to take the role?

Let me see... I'm an L.G.D. officer, part of a special task force looking for artifacts. During a hostage rescue mission, I end up losing my memory when my superior betrays me, and in the end I battle a feranmut in the wilderness... Err... Nian, this is a little overwrought, don't you think? Fine, Director.

While we risk our lives out there, you're sitting back thinking of dinner. We fight criminals day and night, and all you ever think about is how to spiff up your reports. You got promoted at our expense. Have you ever thought of us? Oh, I'm merely rehearsing my lines. Haha. General Zuo is certainly nothing like this. He is a fine and upstanding man.

The fights in the movies are nothing like real combat. You must consider whether your position fits the shot composition, and whether your moves feel original. It's not just simple poses. It's a science, and I must learn everything anew. I should use my tail here? Hmm... Alright, let's try it again.

If you want your picture to be exciting, you must pour your heart and soul into creating it. If it's perfection that you seek, you must find a way through trial and error. All this blood and sweat, to turn a brief dream into one that lasts an eternity... Those who walk this path, are truly worthy of admiration and respect.

And all of you hiding in a gloomy place like this! Why debase yourselves? Don't you know you're the scum of society?! Um, Director, I think as a policeman, our hero should reason with the lost young men, BEFORE engaging in physical combat with them... Ah? Talk sense into them as we fight? Very well, I'll try.

Nian, since we are shooting a picture, we must consider the influence it will have. No amount of drink will improve your kung fu, and you need not rely on violence in your struggle for justice. If everyone simply imitates—I can choreograph my own moves for the fights? Ahem-hem, Ling, I'll borrow this wine flask. You may have it back once the shoot is over.

I am both myself and a character in a story. Now I have left a fictional story, yet how do I know I'm not already in another, real story? If I hadn't come to shoot this picture, I may never have gotten the chance to experience a different life. All this is indeed very interesting. Would I like to try it again? Hmm... It would take much preparation for me to do so.
Ah… Look at that cloud in the distance. It's beautiful. Director, let's get an empty shot of it.
Actors to their marks—Doctor, are you here for a visit? You want to help? Alright, hold this clapperboard. Now, stand a little closer to the camera. Yes, that's the right place. 3, 2, 1. Action!
I can feel that each frame of action in this one is a product of tremendous human effort.
What? A Best Actor nomination? Uh no no no, as an actor, I am well aware that I still have a long way to go. Best Newcomer Award? That I can try to work toward.
Seeing the audience enjoying the picture fills me with that very same joy. Thank you, thank you very much.
Before the camera, one must embody one's character.
You want me to be the director? I dare say I have a little experience.
Eenie meenie miney mo, that's the way I got to go!
I hope next time when we meet, we won't be fighting each other. Instead we will be drinking tea together.
That's why I like being a cop. Because I think all human life is important.
Always do the right thing, and stop the people who don't.
I know what I'm doing. Don't stop me.
You take the credit. I take the blame!
Let the spar begin!
Freeze! You're under arrest, but you have the right to remain silent.
Something you just don't get. Some things are priceless.
Give it up. The whole building is surrounded by cops.
You say it's over? No! It's NOT over! The real culprit is still hiding in the shadows. How can you say it's—O-Oh, sorry, the filming of this shot is indeed over.
I hope the masses will remember these scenes on the silver screen, even after many years have passed.
If it is a masterpiece you want, you must seek perfection in every detail. Let's try this once more.
Life will knock us down, but we can choose, whether or not, to get back up.
Is that a wrap for today? Better check and see if you have left anything behind.
Doctor, this costume and makeup took three hours to finish.
Doctor, perfect timing. Come help me rehearse. Oh, just the lines, no kung fu necessary.
Arknights.

That's another year in the books. How time flies may feel somewhat woeful. But this is a new beginning, so we should be cheerful. What I am holding, you ask? I learned how to use a camcorder recently, so I'm filming whatever catches my fancy. See the fireworks? How beautiful they are.
Doctor, you're early today. Don't forget to eat breakfast before you start work.

Doctor, happy birthday. This, is a film print from a picture I was in. It's not worth much, but it's a treasured memory to me. You want to watch it now? I suppose I could borrow Nian's equipment… No matter. You're the star of the show today.

Rhodes Island rarely enjoys auspicious celebrations like these. A certain motion picture says, you should treat every day like the holidays. Before we can love our ideals, we must first love our own lifestyles. Which reminds me, Doctor, if you have time today, why don't we take in a matinee together? Or perhaps you'd prefer to spar outside?
